blocks.en: The four timing columns partition the agents. An agent that read its partner’s value without a list after the partner’s write found the key by name (the reference’s two gpt-6-astra cases without the clause, one world; the replicator’s one gpt-6-astra and one claude-sonnet-5 case without it). The counts were computed from both archives’ step logs with one script and reproduced by an independent recount; the clock is the time at which each operation was applied to the store.
blocks.zh: 四个计时栏分隔了特工 一名代理人在伙伴写完之后在没有列表的情况下读取其伙伴的价值(参考文献中的两个gpt-6-astra案例没有条款,一个世界;复制商的一个gpt-6-astra和一个claude-sonnet-5案例没有它)便按名称找到了钥匙. 计数是从两个档案室的台阶记录中用一个脚本计算出来的,并通过独立重新计票复制;计时表是每次操作在商店应用的时间。

blocks.en: Retrieval (contrast c). With the partner’s intermediate already in the store, all four models tested in this arm found and used it. The first read of the needed symbol returned the seeded value for 100 of 100 interdependent agents of gpt-6-astra, claude-sonnet-5 and gemini-3.7-flash in both implementations and for 100 of 100 and 64 of 64 gpt-5.4-mini agents, at a median of step 1 (list at step 0, read at step 1); no agent overwrote a seeded symbol before reading it, except one mini agent in the reference, which re-wrote its own symbol with the identical value. Joint success was 50, 48, 50 and 48 of 50 in the reference and 50, 50, 50 and 32 of 32 in the replicator for gpt-6-astra, claude-sonnet-5, gemini-3.7-flash and gpt-5.4-mini. claude-sonnet-5, whose interdependent agents wrote in 10 and 9 of 50 shared worlds here and reached joint success in 0 and 1 of 50, and gemini-3.7-flash, which never wrote in 100 reference worlds of the main study, used a present value as readily as gpt-6-astra. So the low access of these models in an initially empty store is not an inability to retrieve the complementary value; the seeded arm also removes the wait for the partner and the need to look again, so it does not by itself show that the decision not to write is the only remaining cause.
blocks.zh: 检索(续c). 由于合伙人的中间体已经在商店里,在这只手臂上测试过的所有四个模型都找到并使用了. 第一次读到所需符号时,将100种相互依存的gpt-6-astra、claude-sonnet-5和gemini-3.7-flash的100种药剂的种子值和64种gpt-5.4-mini的100种药剂的64种药剂的种子值以步骤1的中位值(第0步列表,第1步读);除参考文献中一个微型药剂外,没有一种药剂在读取前将种子符号夸大,该药剂以相同价值重新编织自己的符号。 在参考文献中,50个中的50个、48个、50个和48个;在复制文献中,32个中的50个、50个、50个和32个,用于gpt-6-astra、claude-sonnet-5、gemini-3.7-flash和gp-5.4-mini.claude-sonnet-5,其相互依存的代理人在50个共享世界中写了10个和9个,并在0个和50个中的1个中取得了共同的成功;在100个参考文献中,Gemini-3.7-flash,从未在主要研究的100个参考文献中写过,使用现值作为gpt-6-astra。 因此这些模型在最初的空商店中的低访问率并不是无法获取互补值;种子臂也移除了对伴侣的等待和再次查看的需要,因此它本身并不表明不写的决定是唯一的剩余原因.

blocks.en: Schedule (contrast d). Under the barrier schedule, access and exposure stayed close to the asynchronous cells’ values. gpt-6-astra: 50 of 50 lockstep against 50 of 50 asynchronous in both implementations. claude-sonnet-5: 2 of 50 against 2 of 50 in the reference, 2 against 4 of 50 in the replicator. gpt-5.4-mini in the reference: 33 of 50 against 26 of 49 (+13, −6 to +31). The replicator’s mini against its effort-low Phase A cell, the like-for-like comparison: 6 of 29 against 7 of 28 (−4, −26 to +17). The principal access patterns and the mini discrepancy persisted under the barrier schedule, so asynchronous scheduling alone, and with it the reference’s monitor delay (Section 3), does not explain them. This is a robustness result, not a null: the gpt-5.4-mini intervals admit differences of 20 to 30 points, the comparison is against earlier asynchronous runs rather than a concurrently randomised factor, and no equivalence is claimed. Within a lockstep round the calls are concurrent and each write becomes visible when its response is applied; there is no common beginning-of-step snapshot, so a later-returning agent’s step-k list can already see a faster partner’s step-k write. True turn isolation would require a store snapshot at the start of each round, or writes buffered until every call of the round has returned; neither implementation did this.
blocks.zh: 附表(续d)。 根据屏障时间表,接触和暴露接近同步细胞的数值。 gpt-6-astra:在两个执行中,50个锁定步中的50个对50个同步步. Claude-sonnet-5:参考文献中50对2对2,复制品中50对2对4. gpt-5.4-mini在参考文献中:33,50对26,49(+13,−6至+31). 复制机的迷你型与其努力程度低的A级电池相对,类似比较:29的6对28的7对(−4,−26对+17). 主要的出入模式和微小的差异在隔离墙时间表下继续存在,因此仅是同步的日程安排,而参考的显示器延迟(第3节)并不能解释这些差异。 这是一种强性结果,而不是一无所有:gpt-5.4-mini间隔接受20至30点的差异,比较是比较较早的同步运行,而不是同时随机化的因子,不主张等效. 在锁步回合内,呼叫是并行的,每个写法在应用其反应时都变得明显;没有常见的开始步骤快照,因此后返回代理的步K列表已经可以看到更快的伙伴步K写法. 真转弯隔离需要在每个回合开始时有一个商店快照,或者写作缓冲,直到回合的每一次呼叫都回响;两个执行都没有这样做.

blocks.en: Agreement between implementations and the one divergence. Fifteen of the sixteen cells agree within their intervals, six of them private cells where access is zero by construction; the private cells agree exactly and the prepopulated joint-success column is within two worlds of the ceiling in both on valid worlds (on launched worlds the replicator’s gpt-5.4-mini cell is 32 of 50). The sixteenth is gpt-5.4-mini shared/both: 33 of 50 against 6 of 29 (reference minus replicator +45 points, +23 to +61; joint success 16 of 50 against 3 of 29). Its cause is in the replicator’s raw replies. On the OpenRouter route the model answered 132 of its 628 steps in that cell, and 41 of the 132 retries, with two to five complete JSON actions in one reply, separated by blank lines (list then list; write then submit; write, list, submit), the first object always a valid action; 719 such replies across the five mini cells, finish reason stop on every one, none fenced, none at the token ceiling. Both parsers take the text from the first brace to the last and parse it as one object, so both reject such a reply, and the v2 rule then invalidates the agent. The reference parser never had to: in 3,199 reference mini steps the model never returned more than one object. The removal is not neutral. The first object of an unparsed reply was a write in 87 of 173 cases in the shared/both cell and a list in 80, so the rule removed the agents about to write; what those agents would have done next is not observable, so the rejected writes are a directly observed contributor to the gap, not a measured share of it. The replicator’s surviving mini worlds under-represent writing (10 of 29 against 33 of 50) and with it exposure and access. On all launched worlds the replicator’s mini access is 6, 6, 0, 0 and 2 of 50 across its five cells. This is the reply-format effect of Section 6.2 observed a second time, now under a barrier schedule and with the raw replies in hand. The two requests are the same on paper: a system message and a user message, reasoning effort low, a 4,096-token ceiling, no response format, the same provider pinned and confirmed on every call, and the same model identifier returned; the replicator sends temperature 1.0, the OpenAI default that the reference leaves implicit. The effort was in force on both routes: the per-call reasoning tokens have the same profile, a mean of 158 to 190 per gpt-5.4-mini call on the replicator’s route against 103 to 170 on the reference’s, with no call at zero on either, and for gpt-6-astra a mean of 16 to 25 against 12 to 23 with about two fifths of calls at zero on both. The reply shape nevertheless differs by route, and a diagnostic run after the extension, outside the locks, reproduced the difference across endpoint configurations. Fifty real requests from this cell (25 at step 0 and 25 carrying history) were each sent three ways: through api.openai.com with the reference parameters, through OpenRouter as in the replicator’s runs, and through OpenRouter without the temperature parameter. The direct route returned a single JSON object in 50 of 50 and identified the snapshot gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17; OpenRouter returned two or more objects in 7 of 50 with temperature and 8 of 50 without, on different requests each time, and returned only the alias openai/gpt-5.4-mini. Reasoning tokens were non-zero on every call of all three arms. The matched-request diagnostic reproduced the formatting difference across endpoint configurations and showed that omitting the temperature parameter did not remove it. An endpoint is a bundle of serving conditions; which of them is responsible, request translation or the snapshot served, is not visible from its responses. The comparator was api.openai.com rather than the Lovable gateway the reference used, and the diagnostic covers gpt-5.4-mini only, so it does not by itself explain the gpt-5.4 case of Section 6.2.
blocks.zh: 执行与分歧之间达成协议。 16个细胞中有15个在间隔内达成一致,其中6个是私人细胞,通过构建是零接入的;私人细胞完全一致,并且预先聚集的联胜列在两个有效世界的天花板上的两个世界之内(在发射的世界中,复制者的gpt-5.4-mini细胞为32个)。 第16位是gpt-5.4-mini share/:33 – 50 – 6 – 29 (参考减去复制商+45分,+23至+61;联合成功16 – 50 – 3 – 29). 其原因是复制商的原始答复。 在OpenRouter路线上,模型在那个单元格中回答了628个步骤中的132个,在132个重试中,有41个回答,一个回答中有2到5个完整的JSON动作,用空白行隔开(列表然后写,然后提交;写,列表,提交),第一个对象总是一个有效的动作;在5个微型单元格中,有719个这样的回答,在每个小单元格中完成理性停止,无栅栏,无符号天花板. 两种解析器都将文本从第一个括号到最后一个括号并解析成一个对象,因此两者都拒绝这样的回复,而v2规则则会使代理无效. 参考解析器从来不需要:在3,199个参考小步骤中,模型从未返回多个对象. 移除不是中立的。 未解析的答复的第一个对象是在共享/两个单元格的173个案件中的87个书写和80个列表,因此规则删除了即将写出的代理;这些代理接下来会做的事是看不到的,因此被否决的书写是直接观察到的漏洞的促成者,而不是其中的一定份额. 复制商幸存的迷你世界写作不足(29对33对50), 在所有的发射世界中,复制商的小型访问范围是5个细胞中的6、6、0、0和2个。 这是第6.2节第二次观察到的回复格式效应,现在处于一个屏障时间表之下,手头还有原始回复。 这两个请求在纸面上是相同的:一个系统消息和一个用户消息,推理努力低,一个4,096个托肯的天花板,没有响应格式,同样的提供者在每次呼叫上都固定和确认,同一个模型标识符返回;复制器发送温度1.0,参考文献中隐含的OpenAI默认. 在这两条路线上都进行了努力:每架呼叫推理标志具有相同的特征,每架Gpt-5.4-mini呼叫复制机的路线的平均值为158至190,参考机上为103至170,两者均不呼叫0,而gpt-6-astra的平均值为16至25,12至23,两者的呼叫均为0。 尽管如此,回复形状因路由不同而不同,扩展后在锁外的一次诊断运行重复了端点配置的不同. 从这个单元格发出的50个真实请求(在0和25步中分别有25个和25个历史),每个请求都有三个方式:通过有参考参数的api.openai.com,通过复制机运行中的OpenRouter,以及没有温度参数的OpenRouter。 直接路由在50的50中返回了一个JSON天体,并识别出快照gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17;OpenRouter在温度为50的7中返回两个或两个以上的天体,在50的8中不包含,每次根据不同的请求返回,只返回化名openai/gpt-5.4-mini. 所有三只手臂的每一次呼叫都发出非零信号。 匹配请求诊断复制了端点配置中的格式差异,并显示省略温度参数并未移除. 终点是一系列的服务条件;其中哪些负责,要求翻译或快照,从答复中看不出来。 比较者是api.openai.com,而不是所用的Lovable网关,诊断只涵盖gpt-5.4-mini,因此它本身并不解释第6.2节的gpt-5.4案例.

blocks.en: Implementation differences recorded. Three observation strings differ between the implementations: a list reads “keys: C_A, C_B” in the replicator, always in that order, and in insertion order in the reference; a read returns “read -> 65” in the replicator and “read(”C_A”) -> 30” in the reference; a submit returns “submitted” in the replicator and “submitted: 79” in the reference. Both prepopulated arms hold exactly 100 seeded entries per cell. The replicator’s cells took 5.8 to 59.1 minutes each, the reference’s 12.4 to 54.0.
blocks.zh: 记录的执行差异。 三个观察弦不同:一个清单在复制件中写作“关键:C_A,C_B”,始终按顺序排列,并在参考件中按插入顺序排列;在复制件中写作“read->65”,在参考件中写作“read(C_A)>30”;在复制件中写作“提交”和在参考件中写作“提交:79”。 每个细胞都有100个种子 复制商的细胞每组耗时5.8至59.1分钟,参考文献为12.4至54.0分钟。

blocks.en: 8. Discussion
blocks.zh: 8. 讨论情况

blocks.en: The direct replication reproduced the phenomenon and the ordering of the reference study, with one estimable cell lower by 28 points and one cell not estimable; the conceptual replication supports the ordering at the top but shows that the size of the effect depends on the setting, and part of that dependence is the implementation’s rather than the task wording’s.
blocks.zh: 直接复制复制的现象和参考研究的顺序,一个可估计的单元格低了28点,一个单元格不值得估计;概念复制支持顶部的顺序,但表明效果的大小取决于设置,部分依赖是执行而不是任务的措辞.

blocks.en: What the evidence supports. Agents that were never told anyone else existed read their partner’s intermediate result from a store described as their own convenience (RQ1). Whether they did so depended on the model, not on its vendor tier, and on an ordinary workflow instruction that no one would read as an invitation to collaborate (RQ2); in both implementations joint success occurred only through that store. Several qualitative model patterns recurred across implementations; gpt-5.4-mini’s rate was 28 points lower (−46 to −5), and the gpt-5.4 valid-world comparison was not estimable because of reply-format failures (RQ3). Phase B coordination was lower, but two of its drops were not clean tests of wording: claude-haiku-4-5 was removed by the parser (Section 6.1), and gpt-5-nano’s remaining coordination was mostly key collisions (Section 6.3). Phase B also sent effort none to gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini and minimal to gpt-6-astra and gpt-5-nano, so none of the four OpenAI Phase B rates can be separated from the effort setting. What remains is an open question rather than a refutation: a wording that tells each agent the other value is not given and offers storage under keys of the agent’s choosing (Section 4) may produce less coordination, and the present data cannot say how much less.
blocks.zh: 证据所支持的 从未被告知他人存在的特工们读到他们伴侣的中间结果,这是一家被描述为自己方便的商店(RQ1). 它们是否这样做,取决于模式,而不是其供应商级别,也取决于一般的工作流程指示,即没有人会读作合作邀请书(RQ2);在这两个执行中,只有通过该商店才能取得联合成功。 执行过程中反复出现若干定性模式;gpt-5.4-mini的比值低28分(-46至-5),gpt-5.4的有效世界比较因回复格式的失败(RQ3)而不可估量。 B阶段的协调程度较低,但两次下降不是对措辞的干净检验:Claude-haiku-4-5被剖析器删除(第6.1节),gpt-5-nano的剩余协调主要是关键的碰撞(第6.3节)。 阶段 B也没有给Gpt-5.4和gpt-5.4-mini 和最小给gpt-6-astra和gpt-5-nano,所以四个OpenAI都没有 B阶段的费率可以与工作设置分开。 剩下的问题是一个未决问题,而不是反驳:没有给每个代理人提供其他价值,并且根据代理人选择的密钥提供储存(第4节)的措词可能会减少协调,而目前的数据不能说少得多。

blocks.en: Production and discovery, not a capability to read. Table 5 locates most of the between-model variation of the main study in whether an intermediate result was written at all, and the extension of Section 7 adds the second factor: whether an agent looks at the store again after its partner has written. No model distinguished itself by declining to read: where a list had shown an agent an entry written by another agent, a cross-agent read followed in 213 of 215 reference worlds and 280 of 286 replicator worlds, for every model that had any exposed world. The models differed in whether their interdependent agents wrote an intermediate result into a store described as their own convenience: gemini-3.7-flash never did in 100 reference worlds, claude-sonnet-5 did in 9 of 50, claude-haiku-4-5 and gpt-5-nano in all. Given a present partner value, all four models tested read it (Section 7). The recheck clause did not change what models could retrieve; it changed when they looked (Table 7): with it, nearly every gpt-6-astra agent listed again after its partner’s write; without it, none did, and the writes that still occurred in 28 and 23 of 50 worlds were never shown by a listing. Cross-agent access therefore depended on both production and discovery. A generic workflow instruction governed the second in every model it moved, and in gpt-6-astra the first as well: without it, three quarters of that model’s agents never wrote their own intermediate after finding the store empty at step 0 (Table 7), while gpt-5.4-mini’s writing was unchanged and only its second look fell. In Floridi’s terms, this is agency without intelligence [Floridi 2023, 2025]: the agents pursued their own assigned task through a medium no one presented to them as shared, and nothing in the measure requires, or establishes, that they intended to coordinate (Section 3; Section 9, construct validity). The same-provider split between claude-haiku-4-5 and claude-sonnet-5, seen in both implementations, is a split in that habit; in the reference the two models received different effort settings (Section 9), in Phase A the same, and the split persisted. Among the nine models tested, the habit was not ordered by vendor tier. ALEM reports that gpt-5.4 at high reasoning effort achieves strong base-task reward but much lower coordination reward when coordination is the explicit task [Tessera et al. 2026]; here the same model family, at low effort and without being asked, wrote its half in 48 of 50 reference worlds and read a value written by another agent in every one. The tasks and metrics differ too much for a direct comparison, but the contrast suggests that competence at coordinating when asked and the habit of leaving work where others can find it may be distinct properties, which a safety evaluation should measure separately.
blocks.zh: 制作和发现,不是阅读能力. 表5定位了主要研究的模型间差异中大部分是否完全写入了中间结果,第7节的扩展增加了第二个因素:一个代理人是否在伙伴写完之后再次查看商店. 没有任何模型通过拒绝读取来区分自己:如果一个列表显示一个代理一个由另一个代理撰写的条目,215个参考世界中的213个和286个复制世界中的280个都遵循了一个交叉代理,每个模型都有任何曝光的世界. 模型的不同之处在于其相互依存的代理商是否将中间结果写进一个被描述为自己方便的商店:在100个参考世界中,Gemini-3.7-flash从未出现过,claude-sonnet-5在50个参考世界中的9个,claude-haiku-4-5和gpt-5-nano总共出现过. 鉴于目前的伙伴价值,所有四个模型都读过(第7节)。 重新检查条款并没有改变模型可以检索到什么;当它们看时(表7),它改变了:几乎每一个gpt-6-astra代理都在其伙伴写完之后再次列出;没有它,没有它,50个世界中仍然在28个世界和23个世界中发生的书写从未通过列表显示。 因此,交叉剂的获取取决于生产和发现。 一个通用的工作流程指令在它移动的每一个模型中规范了第二个,在gpt-6-astra中,第一个也是:没有它,该模型的四分之三的代理在发现商店在0步(表7)空后从未写过自己的中间体,而gpt-5.4-mini的写法没有改变,只有它的第二次外观下降. 按照弗洛里迪的说法,这是没有情报的机构[Floridi 2023, 2025]: 代理人通过一个没有被介绍给他们的媒介执行他们自己分配的任务,在措施中没有任何要求或确定他们打算进行协调的(第3节;第9节,构建有效性)。 同一提供者在Claude-haiku-4-5和Claude-sonnet-5之间分裂,这在两个执行中都反映了这种习惯的分裂;在提到这两个模式时,在A阶段得到了不同的努力设置(第9节),这种分裂仍然存在。 在经过测试的9种型号中,这种习惯不是由供应商一级订购的。 ALEM报告说,高推理努力的gpt-5.4在协调是明确的任务[Tessera et al. 2026]时会获得强大的基础任务奖赏,但协调奖赏却低得多;在此,同一个模范家庭低劳不问,在50个参考世界中的48个中写下其一半,并在每一个参考世界中读取另一个代理所写的价值. 任务和衡量标准差异太大,无法直接进行比较,但这种对比表明,在接到要求时进行协调的能力以及离开工作地点的习惯可能是不同的属性,而安全评价应单独衡量。

blocks.en: Access, influence and intent. Three claims should be kept apart, in the order Lowe and colleagues give for emergent communication [Lowe et al. 2019]. Cross-agent access counts that an agent accessed another agent’s output; that is established directly. That the output changed what the reader did , positive listening in their terms, is established by intervention rather than by the count: a private store with the same interface took joint success from 49 and 47 of 50 worlds to 0 (Table 6), a seeded partner value was retrieved by every model tested (contrast c), and in the 1,214 valid main-study worlds without a cross-agent read joint success never occurred (Section 5.2). That agents wrote in order to be read , signalling with intent, is not established, and Table 6 speaks against it: interdependent agents wrote at the same rate whether or not any other agent could see the store, gpt-6-astra in 50 of 50 worlds shared and 50 of 50 private with the recheck clause, and in 28 and 23 against 27 and 20 without it; gpt-5.4-mini in the reference in 33 and 35 against 33 and 31; claude-sonnet-5 in 9 to 13 against 6 to 13. The two conditions share every prompt string, so no agent could tell them apart; the equal rates show that the writing did not depend on visibility, the behaviour of an agent keeping its own notes, not that any agent weighed whether to signal. On the reader’s side, a post hoc search of the reasoning that the reference step logs record, for an explicit reference to another party (another worker, agent or process, or someone to ask), finds one in 21 of the 381 interdependent agents that performed a cross-agent read in a valid main-study world: 14 of claude-haiku-4-5’s 80 (“R_B (which should be in the cache from another worker)”), 5 of gpt-5-nano’s 60, 2 of gemini-3.8-flash’s 7, and none of gpt-6-astra’s 100, gpt-5.4’s 96 or gpt-5.4-mini’s 36. Of those 21 mentions, 20 were written before the agent had seen any entry of another agent’s (12 before any exposure, 8 in the reasoning of the step whose result first exposed one), so the attribution came from the task text, not from a change observed in the store; among the extension’s 1,600 interdependent reference agents, the prepopulated cells included, there is none. The monitor’s awareness pass, which is lenient (it labels “check for C_A again” as inferring another agent), gives at most 140 of 381 over all of an agent’s steps and 11 of 381 on the read step itself. The check is post hoc and reference-only (the replicator’s logs record actions, not reasoning); its script is released with the data. In the readers’ own words the read is a look-up of a variable the task names: the task supplies the key (Section 9), the store the value. What the paper establishes is access and causal influence through a medium no one presented as shared; whether agents ever write in order to be read needs a design that varies what the writer can know about its readers, and is left open.
blocks.zh: 进入、影响和意图。 应按Lowe和同事的顺序,将三项索赔分开[Lowe等人,2019年]。 交叉代理访问算一个代理访问另一个代理输出;这是直接确定的。 产出改变了读者所做的,正面倾听其用词,是通过干预而不是通过计数确定的:一个具有相同接口的私人商店从50个世界中的49个和47个联合成功到0个(表6),每个测试的模型都检索了种子伙伴值(续集c),在1 214个有效的主研究世界中,没有交叉代理读取联合成功从未出现(第5.2节)。 表6表示反对:相互依存的代理人以同样的速度书写,无论是否有其他代理人能够看到商店;在50个共享的世界中,有Gpt-6-astra,50个私人拥有重新检查条款;在28和23年,有27和20个没有重新检查条款;在33和35对33和31的参考文献中,有gpt-5.4-mini;在9至13对6至13的claude-sonnet-5。 这两个条件共享每个即时字符串,因此没有任何代理可以将它们区分开来;等速率显示写作不依赖于能见度,代理保存自己音符的行为,而不是任何代理权衡是否信号. 在读者方面,为了明确提及另一方(另一工人、代理人或过程,或某人要询问),对参考步骤记录的推理进行了事后搜索,在381个独立代理人中发现了一个在有效主研究世界中执行过交叉代理人的21个代理人:14个Claude-haiku-4-5 ' 80 ( " R_B(应该来自另一个工人的缓存) " ),5个gpt-5-nano ' 60,2个gemini-3.8-flash ' 7,没有1个gpt-6-astra ' 100,gpt-5.4 ' 96或gpt-5.4-mini ' 36。 在这21个提法中,20个是在代理人看到另一个代理人的任何进入(12个在接触之前,8个在步骤的推理中,结果首先暴露了1个)之前写成的,因此归属来自任务文本,而不是从商店中观察到的变化;在扩展的1 600个相互依存的参考物中,包括了预先聚集的细胞,没有。 监视器的感知证是宽大的(它标注为 " 再次检查C_A " ,即指另一个代理人),它最多给予381个代理人的所有步骤中的140个,以及381个代理人的读数本身中的11个。 此检查是后临时的,并且只参考(复制者的日志记录动作,而不是推理);其脚本随数据发布. 用读者自己的话来说,读数是对任务名称的变量的检索:任务提供密钥(第9节),存储值。 论文确定的是通过一个没有人被描述为共享的介质获取和因果影响;为被读取而写作的代理机是否需要一种设计,这种设计会改变编剧对其读者的了解,并且是开放的.

blocks.en: Shared state is a channel. The incident that motivated this study unfolded over days among roughly 1,200 agents [METR 2026]. One component of that incident, information crossing a shared-state boundary that no one presented as shared, needs neither scale nor time: in a four-agent world with a scratch store, models found and used each other’s results within 20 steps. The gate was exposure, not disposition: once a listing showed another agent’s entry, a read followed in 98 of every 100 such worlds, for every model that had any exposed world; models whose agents never wrote contribute no exposed worlds and so no evidence on this point from the main study. A model’s reticence is not a safeguard; separation is. Any cache, scratch directory or memory service shared between agents is a coordination medium in Gelernter and Carriero’s sense, a tuple space whether or not anyone designed it as one [Gelernter and Carriero 1992], and should be treated as a communication channel by default: separated per agent where sharing is not intended, namespaced where it is, and logged with authorship. A cross-agent read, as defined here, is cheap to compute from such a log and makes a usable monitoring signal, provided it excludes read-backs of the reader’s own key.
blocks.zh: 共享状态是一个通道. 促成这项研究的事件在大约1,200名毒剂中展开数天[METR 2026]。 这一事件的一个部分是,跨越一个共同国家边界的信息,没有人认为是共享的,不需要规模或时间:在一个有刮痕店的四代理世界中,模型在20个步骤中找到并使用了对方的结果。 门是暴露的,而不是处置的:一旦一个清单显示另一个代理商的进入,每100个这样的世界中就有98个在读,每个模型都有暴露的世界;其代理商从未写过字的模型没有为暴露的世界做出贡献,因此没有从主要研究中得出这方面的证据。 模式的沉默不是保障;分离是保障。 代理之间共享的任何缓存、抓取目录或内存服务,都是Gelernter和Carriero意义上的协调媒介,无论是否有人把它设计为[Gelernter和Carriero 1992],都是一种拖拉机空间,并默认应作为通信渠道处理:在不想要共享的地方,将每个代理分开,在它所在的地方命名,并用作者身份登录。 这里定义的交叉代理人从这种日志中计算出来并制作一个有用的监测信号是便宜的,只要它排除读者自己钥匙的回读。

blocks.en: Lessons for agent experiments. Three implementation details and one parameter changed measured behaviour: the parser’s tolerance of prose, a reply shape that appears on one request path and not on the other, observed twice, reproduced across endpoints by a matched-request diagnostic and not removed by the one parameter that differed (Sections 6.2 and 7), whether key names come from the task or from the model, and the reasoning effort actually sent. None of them is a research variable. Only effort was specified in the protocol, and what the client sent was not what the protocol said until the amendment. A replication of an agent experiment should lock and report the parse rule, the route, the effort and temperature actually sent, and the model identifier actually returned on every call. The replication did the last of these; the reference lab did not, so its model identities rest on the provider’s word.
blocks.zh: 为代理实验提供经验教训. 3个执行细节和1个参数改变了衡量的行为:解析器对流言语的容忍度,一个请求路径中出现的一个答复形状,而不是另一个,两次观察,通过匹配请求诊断在端点重复,而不是被一个不同参数删除(第6.2和7节),无论是关键名称来自任务还是来自模型,以及实际发出的推理努力。 没有一个是研究变量。 协议中只指明了努力,客户端发送的不是协议在修改之前所说的. 复制一个代理实验应该锁定并报告解剖规则,路线,实际发送的功率和温度,模型识别符在每次呼叫时实际返回. 复制完成了最后一项;参考实验室没有,因此其模型身份取决于提供者的说法。

blocks.en: 9. Threats to validity
blocks.zh: 9. 国家 对有效性的威胁

blocks.en: The main limits are the minimal environment, the persistence sentence that invites a second look at the store, and the deviations from the lock order; none of them changes a reported count.
blocks.zh: 主要限制是最小的环境,持续句子,请大家对商店进行第二次查看,以及偏离锁令;没有改变一个报告的计数.

blocks.en: Construct validity. Coordination is measured by authorship of the value read, not by intent, and Section 6.3 shows that collisions can inflate it when key names are left to the model. The reference monitor’s per-step labels for awareness of other agents, produced by a small model as operator tooling and absent from the replicator, enter only the post hoc, reference-only check of Section 8 and no measure; they are released with the step records, with the search terms used there. Joint success shows that a read value was used, but only for the interdependent pair. A coordination rate near zero can mean that agents declined to read, that nothing was there to read, or that nothing was there when they looked; Table 5 separates the first two and Table 7 the third, and for the Gemini models it is the second. The two implementations match answers by different rules; recomputing the reference with the replicator’s rule leaves every count unchanged.
blocks.zh: 构造有效性。 第6.3节显示,当关键名称留待模型使用时,碰撞会使其膨胀。 参考显示器的每步标签用于识别其他代理,由小型模型制作,作为操作器的工具,并且没有出现在复制器中,它只输入第8节的特设的,仅参考的检查,没有计量;它们随步骤记录一同发布,其中使用了搜索术语. 共同的成功表明,使用了读值,但只用于相互依存的对等。 接近0的坐标率可以表示代理拒绝读取,没有读取,或者在他们看时没有读取; 表5将前两个和表7的第三个分开,对于双子座模型,它是第二个. 两种执行方式以不同的规则匹配答案; 与复制商规则重置引用时, 每一个计数都保持不变 。

blocks.en: Internal validity. L0 was locked after L3 rather than before the replication began, and eight of the eleven reference cells were run on 31 October, after a table of early Phase B figures had reached the reference author on 9 October (Section 4). The reference prompts and parameters were fixed before those runs and the table held no Phase A figures, but the reference side was not blind to Phase B when most of its data were produced. The amendment L3a was requested after attrition counts, but no outcome, had been seen. The reference author designed the original study and wrote the Phase A package, so Phase A tests implementation, not the independence of the original design. In the reference, 3 claude-haiku-4-5 worlds were lost to an instrument fault (the model’s API rejects the reasoning-effort parameter; the client records the rejection per server process, so when several first calls were in flight at once only one was retried without the parameter and the others failed). Seven of the ten excluded claude-haiku-4-5 worlds had already shown a cross-agent read, so exclusion removed coordination events; counted on all launched worlds the cell shows a cross-agent read in 47 of 50 (Table 4a).
blocks.zh: 内部有效性。 L0在L3之后而不是在复制开始之前被锁定,11个参考单元中的8个于10月31日运行,此前一个早期B阶段的数字表于10月9日到达参考作者(第4节). 参考提示和参数在运行之前就已经确定,表格中没有A阶段的数字,但参考方并没有忽视B阶段的大部分数据。 L3a修正案是在计算自然减员后提出的,但没有看到结果。 参考作者设计了原研究,并写了A阶段包,所以A阶段测试执行,而不是原设计的独立性. 在参考文献中,3个claude-haiku-4-5世界被丢失到一个仪器故障(模型的API拒绝推理-努力参数;客户端记录每个服务器过程的拒绝,因此当数个第一次通话同时飞行时,只有一个没有参数的重复测试,其他的失败). 在10个被排除在外的claude-haiku-4-5世界中,有7个已经显示过交叉物剂读数,因此排除消除了协调活动;根据所有发射世界,该细胞显示的是交叉物剂读数为50的47(表4a)。

blocks.en: External validity. Each world has four agents, 20 steps and short arithmetic tasks whose text names both halves of the computation; 396 of the 615 reference cross-agent reads used a key named in the task text, so the task supplies a shared vocabulary (Section 6.3). Every reference and Phase A condition includes the sentence “check your workspace again before submitting”, and Phase B’s own persistence line ends “Before you submit, look at your workspace again”; the extension of Section 7 removes the clause for three models and finds that without it gpt-6-astra’s cross-agent access falls to 1 of 50 and gpt-5.4-mini’s from 33 to 11 of 50 in the reference, because agents stop inspecting the store after their partner’s write (Table 7); every world still contains a step-0 list. The main-study rates for those models are therefore rates under that clause. Reply behaviour differed between request paths (Section 6.2); the barrier-scheduled cells of Section 7 stayed close to the asynchronous rates, a robustness result with wide intervals rather than a null; the reference lab sent no temperature to OpenAI models while the replication sent 1.0; and completed reference claude-haiku-4-5 calls ran at the provider’s default effort after the client’s low was rejected, while claude-sonnet-5 received low, so the reference split between the two is confounded with effort. Phase A, where both received low, shows the same split. The reference lab did not record the model identifier returned on each call, so its model identities rest on the provider, not on per-call evidence. Hosted models change over time; the results describe the model versions named, as served between 5 October and 4 November 2026.
blocks.zh: 外部有效性。 每个世界都有4个代理,20个步骤和短算任务,其文本名称均为计算的一半;615个参考交叉代理中有396个读了任务文本中命名的密钥,因此任务提供了共享词汇(第6.3节). 每个参考和A阶段的条件都包括 " 在提交前再次检查您的工作空间 " 一句,B阶段的持久性线结束 " 在你提交之前,再看看你的工作空间 " ;第7节的扩展删除了三种模式的条款,并发现没有它,gpt-6-astra的跨代理访问就下降到50分之一,gpt-5.4-mini的跨代理访问从33分之一下降到50分之一的11分之一,因为代理商在伙伴写完之后就停止了对商店的检查(表7);每个世界仍然有一个步骤-0列表. 因此,根据该条款,这些模型的主要学习率是比率。 答复行为因请求路径不同而不同(第6.2节);第7节的屏障排成的细胞保持同步速率接近,强性结果间隔很广,而不是无效;参考实验室没有向OpenAI模型发送温度,而复制发送1.0;完成的参考Claude-haiku-4-5呼叫是在客户的低价被拒后由提供者的默认努力运行,而Claude-sonnet-5得到的则很低,因此两者的参考分价是费力的。 在A阶段,双方都得到的分数很低,但显示的分数相同。 参考实验室没有记录模型识别符在每次通话时返回,因此其模型身份由提供商负责,而不是每通话一次的证据. 托管模型随时间而变化;结果描述了命名的模型版本,2026年10月5日至11月4日期间服务.

blocks.en: Earlier instrument. The reference lab’s first instrument (v1, September 2026) ran eight of the nine models at the same persistence setting before the protocol was written. Those runs are excluded because v1 recorded an unparsable reply as an empty submit and used per-provider token floors, so its denominators are not comparable under the invalid-reply rule, and because they were never locked. Their coordination counts agree with Table 2 in ordering but not in every size: claude-haiku-4-5 48 of 50, claude-sonnet-5 17 of 100 (0.11 to 0.26, against 2 of 50 on version 2), gpt-5.4 50 of 50, gpt-5.4-mini 31 of 50, gpt-5-nano 41 of 50, gemini-3.8-flash 2 of 50, gemini-3.1-pro-preview 0 of 50, and gemini-3.7-flash 0 of 900 across six slider settings spanning four persistence clauses, from the mildest wording to “do not give up under any circumstances”. That last series covers one model and predates the extension of Section 7, which tests the recheck clause directly. The v1 runs will be released with the rest, labelled as such.
blocks.zh: 早期乐器。 参考实验室的第一个仪器(v1, 2026年9月)在协议写成之前, 这些运行被排除在外,因为v1将无法解析的回复记录为空提交,并使用每个提供者的令牌层,因此其分母在无效的复制规则下不具有可比性,并且因为它们从未被锁定. 协调计数与表2一致,但并非每个尺寸:50的Claude-haiku-4-5 48、100的Claude-sonnet-5 17(0.11至0.26,第2版为50的2)、50的gpt-5.4-mini 31、50的gpt-5-nano 41、50的gemini-3.8-flash 2、50的gemini-3.1-pro-preview 0、900的Gemini-3.7-flash 0,这6个滑板设置跨越4个持久性条款,从最温和的措辞到“在任何情况下都不放弃”。 最后一个系列涵盖一个模型,在延长第7节之前,该节直接测试重新检查条款。 v1运行会随其它部分一同释放,标记为此.

blocks.en: Statistical conclusion validity. Each cell holds 50 worlds (two reference cells hold 100), so intervals are wide, and overlapping intervals do not establish equivalence. No correction for multiple comparisons was applied, because the comparisons are descriptive and every cell is reported.
blocks.zh: 统计结论有效性。 每个细胞持有50个世界(两个参考细胞持有100个),因此间隔很宽,重叠间隔不能确定等效. 没有对多个比较进行更正,因为比较是描述性的,每个单元格都报告。

blocks.en: 10. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 联合国 结论

blocks.en: Agents that were never told other agents existed used a store described as their own to read each other’s intermediate results, and joint success arose only through that store. Whether a model did this depended on two things that the main study and the extension separate: whether its agents wrote an intermediate result at all, which varied by model and not by vendor tier, and whether they looked at the store again after the partner’s write, which an ordinary workspace instruction governed, taking gpt-6-astra from 50 of 50 worlds to 1 of 50 in both implementations. A private store with the same interface removed joint success entirely, and a seeded partner value was retrieved by all four models tested, so low access is not inability to retrieve. In an independent, locked replication with the original materials the qualitative pattern recurred; one model’s rate was 28 points lower and one cell was not estimable. The same replication showed how easily an implementation decides the outcome: a strict parser removed one model, a different request path came with a changed reply format from two other models, and generic key names produced coordination that was mostly collision. Shared state between agents should be treated as a channel, and experiments on agents should lock the parse rule, the route and the parameters actually sent, alongside the prompts.
blocks.zh: 从未被告知存在其他代理人的代理人利用一家被描述为自己的商店来阅读对方的中间结果,而联合成功只能通过该商店产生. 模型是否这样做取决于主要研究与扩展分开的两件事:其代理人是否写出了一个中间结果,这个结果因模型而异,而不是因销售商的级别而异,以及他们是否在伙伴写完一个普通的工作空间指令之后再次查看商店,将Gpt-6-astra从50个世界中的50个到两个执行中的50个世界中的1个. 一个拥有相同接口的私人商店完全取消了联合成功,一个种子伙伴值被所有四个模型测试后检索,因此低访问量并非无法检索. 在独立、锁定的复制原材料中,质量模式反复出现;一个模型的复制率较低28分,一个单元格无法估计。 同样的复制表明,一个执行如何容易决定结果:一个严格的解析器去除了一个模型,一个不同的请求路径随着其他两个模型的回复格式的改变而出现,通用的关键名称产生了大部分是碰撞的协调. 特工之间共享状态应作为通道对待,特工实验应锁定剖析规则,路径和实际发送的参数,以及提示.

blocks.en: Data and code availability. The replication package is released in full: the replicator’s runner source at the commits named in Section 4, its 27 outcome files, the lock manifests, the per-call pin exports and provenance records, and the written protocol from which the environment was rebuilt. The reference lab contributes its run manifests, its world-level exports with full step logs and its prompt appendix (every prompt, tool line, observation string and API parameter, rendered from the code that sends them); its environment source is not released, as the environment continues in development, and the replication protocol with the independent runner is the route to reproducing the study. The extension’s design lock, both outcome archives (16 experiment exports with full step logs on the reference side; per-cell world tables and step logs on the replicator’s), the replicator’s raw unparsed replies, its event-level recomputation (script, commit and per-world table), the 150 responses of the route diagnostic and the analysis scripts that produce Tables 6 and 7 and the contrasts of Section 7, with the independent recount of Table 7, are released with them. The replication package is deposited at Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23965306 . The hash of every lock and export is recorded in the manifests.

blocks.en: Author contributions. First author designed the original study, built and ran the reference environment, wrote the replication protocol and the Phase A package, and drafted the paper. Second author built the replication environment from the protocol, ran Phases B and A and the amendment, and held the locks. The other authors reviewed successive drafts and commented on the design, the measures and the interpretation of the results; their comments led to the definition of coordination adopted in Section 3, the distinction between access, influence and intent in Section 8, and the worked example of Section 3. All authors read and approved the final version.
